info.title: Vera P0 API
info.description: Implementation target per ADR-0003. Only health/readiness implemented.

CreateTask.description: Confirms a server-side research plan. Skill, subject, params and data scope come from the plan, never from this request.

classification.description: Industry taxonomy and version, e.g. SW2021 L2

CreatePlan.description: Either free text or a structured skill+subject request. Free text is untrusted input used only for parsing.

params.description: Validated server-side against the skill's params_schema from GET /api/v1/skills.
